_description: Mapping of fault_category to its sub-fault names. Used by the aggregation+hypothesis pipeline to group flat per-run metrics files by category when fault_category is missing from a document. Sub-fault values must match the 'injected_fault_name' / 'fault_name' field in per-run metric documents.
_known_collisions: misconfigured-kubernetes-horizontal-pod-autoscaler appears in both application_fault and finops_fault below. It is the same ITBench mechanism reused under two different framings (SRE availability vs. FinOps cost scenario, ITBench scenario index 38) and shares one fault_name. Because subfault_to_category is a flat fault_name-keyed dict, only the category processed last wins for this fault_name at runtime -- the two entries are not both honored simultaneously. See docs/Methodologies/02-Experiment-Design/2.3-Fault-Taxonomy.md section 3 for details.
